turns.say: I’ll make a warm retro open mic poster with your exact wording. The supported portrait format is 9:16, so it will need cropping or margins for your requested A4/3:4 print.

image.prompt: Use generate_image to create one print-ready open mic night poster in a portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, composed for A4 printing with generous safe margins. Use a warm retro, flat graphic style, viewed straight on with no perspective, room setting, frame, or mockup. Place the exact words "Open Mic Night" across the upper third in large, rounded, slightly condensed 1970s-style lettering, dark chocolate brown with a restrained burnt-orange offset shadow. Center a bold illustration of a vintage silver microphone beneath the headline: ribbed metal grille, charcoal detailing, slender stand, and a looping cable forming a loose curve near the bottom. Add simple mustard-yellow starbursts and terracotta sound-wave shapes around the microphone without crowding the text. Place "Friday 7pm" centered below the illustration in substantial dark-brown sans-serif lettering, then "The Blue Door" centered at the bottom in bold muted teal type. Use an oatmeal-cream paper ground with subtle fibers, fine screen-print grain, and gently imperfect ink edges. Keep illumination even and neutral, with no photographic shadows. All lettering must remain crisp and readable; include no additional words, logos, or branding.
